propDocs.Input.disabled: Prevents editing and removes the input from the tab order.
propDocs.Input.readOnly: Prevents editing while permitting focus and selection.
propDocs.Input.required: Requires a value for native form validation.
propDocs.Input.type: Native input type, such as text, search, email or url.
propDocs.Input.defaultValue: Initial editable value; the demo remounts when its destination control changes.
propDocs.InputGroup.children: Input, optional text or icons, and an optional InputClear button.
